PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Built for Long-Distance Loads · 13 m Straight Frame · T700C Steel · FUWA 13 t Axles

The EHJ9400LB is a key model in Hubei Ouyang Jude's drop-side range. Its tapered main beams, reinforced front longitudinal plates and diagonal bracing support demanding long-distance and interprovincial haulage.

FUWA 13 t axles, 12R22.5 radial tires, air brakes (4 dual + 2 single chambers) and KOMEE ABS contribute to cornering stability, suspension wear resistance and durability proven through years of use. Xiangqi is listed in China's vehicle type-approval catalog, with factory-direct sales and after-sales support across 30+ provincial regions.

FEATURES

Key Features

Five Structural Features · Designed for Durability

01 SUSPENSION

Reinforced Leaf Springs

13 mm high-strength leaf springs improve stability and reduce body roll during cornering while resisting suspension wear and fatigue over extended use.

02 AXLE

Heavy-Duty Springs and Rims

Heavy-duty rims and 12R22.5 radial tires work with an optional pneumatic lifting axle for efficiency when empty and stability when loaded, together with FUWA 13 t axles and KOMEE ABS.

03 MAIN BEAM

Tapered Main Beams

Tapered main beams and reinforced front longitudinal welds work with diagonal bracing to strengthen the body. Main beam height: 500 mm.

04 SIDE BEAM

Reinforced Side Beams

Bottom and transverse reinforcement creates strong, durable connections. Continuous channel sections and deep lower channels support sustained heavy loads.

05 MOLDING

Integrated Press-Formed Structure

Integrated front and rear press forming with added reinforcement includes strengthened welded joints to improve durability and load resistance.
